title: 🧡 Naina unwraps her last orange sweet… who is the girl by the pillar? #shorts #kidsstory #kindness
title_alts: 🧡 Why does Naina's hand stop at her chin with the sweet right there? #shorts #kidsstory #kindness
🧡 On the bench Naina's hand stops at her chin… what did she just see? #shorts #kidsstory #kindness
refrain: One, two, three - snap, snap, snap.
description_hook: Naina has one sweet left and a long wait for the train. Then a smaller passenger notices it.

characters.name: Naina
characters.description: seven years old, short bobbed hair with a blue band, orange kurta, a small red backpack

characters.name: Pihu
characters.description: a three-year-old girl, two tiny plaits, pink frock, bare feet, clutching a cloth doll

scenes.narration: Naina unwrapped her last orange sweet on the platform bench. "One, two, three - snap, snap, snap," she sang. She had wanted it since morning: three bites, all hers.
scenes.caption: नैना ने प्लेटफ़ॉर्म की बेंच पर आख़िरी संतरे की मिठाई खोली - “एक, दो, तीन - चट, चट, चट।”
scenes.image_brief: Naina, a seven-year-old girl with short bobbed hair and a blue hair band, orange kurta, sitting on a stone railway platform bench unwrapping a small orange sweet, mouth open mid-song, small red backpack beside her, warm late-morning light

scenes.narration: She turned her shoulder and bit once, fast, but the paper crackled loudly.
scenes.caption: उसने कंधा घुमाकर जल्दी से एक कुतरा लिया, पर काग़ज़ खड़खड़ा उठा।
scenes.image_brief: Naina on the platform bench turned side-on with one shoulder raised, taking a quick bite of the orange sweet, the crinkling paper wrapper in her other hand, red backpack beside her, bright daylight

scenes.narration: The crackle brought Pihu to the bench with her cloth doll, both palms open. Can you see her? Only one sweet left, and now two mouths and a doll.
scenes.caption: खड़खड़ सुनकर पीहू गुड़िया लिए आ गई - मिठाई बस एक, हिस्सेदार दो।
scenes.image_brief: Pihu, a three-year-old in a pink frock with two tiny plaits, barefoot, a cloth doll under one arm and both palms held open, standing at the knee of Naina, who sits on the platform bench with the half-eaten orange sweet, soft shade

scenes.narration: So Naina folded the wrapper over the sweet and pressed down hard with her thumb. Snap it with me. "One, two, three - snap, snap, snap."
scenes.caption: नैना ने काग़ज़ मोड़कर अंगूठे से दबाया - “एक, दो, तीन - चट, चट, चट।”
scenes.image_brief: Close view of Naina's hands pressing the folded paper wrapper flat against the platform bench with her thumb, the orange sweet breaking into three pieces inside the paper, orange kurta sleeve above, bright daylight

scenes.narration: The sweet broke into pieces. Naina gave Pihu the biggest, tucked one in the doll’s lap, and licked sugar off the paper.
scenes.caption: सबसे बड़ा टुकड़ा पीहू को, एक गुड़िया की गोद में, और नैना ने काग़ज़ चाटा।
scenes.image_brief: Naina holding out the biggest piece of orange sweet to Pihu, a third piece tucked in the cloth doll's lap, Naina licking sugar from the empty paper wrapper, both girls on the platform bench, warm light

scenes.narration: Sticky chins all round. "One, two, three - snap, snap, snap," said Naina, and her grin would not sit still.
scenes.caption: चिपचिपी ठुड्डियाँ, और नैना की हँसी रुकने का नाम नहीं ले रही थी।
scenes.image_brief: Naina and Pihu side by side on the platform bench with the cloth doll propped between them, three sticky chins, the folded wrapper on the bench, Naina grinning wide, afternoon shade

title: 😶 Dhruv wishes the whole noisy bus would go quiet… then it really does #shorts #kidsstory #storytime
title_alts: 😶 Why does Dhruv stop wishing for quiet the moment the bus empties? #shorts #kidsstory #storytime
😶 On the bus Dhruv covers both ears, and the voices only come closer… #shorts #kidsstory #storytime
refrain: Buzz, bump, buzz, bump - one stop.
description_hook: Dhruv wishes the noisy bus would go quiet. Then it does, and that is when the real trouble starts.

characters.name: Dhruv
characters.description: eight years old, straight hair pushed flat by a cap, grey school shirt, a canvas bag on his knees

scenes.narration: Dhruv pressed his forehead to the rattling window and wished everybody would stop talking. "Buzz, bump, buzz, bump - one stop," he grumbled. Four to go.
scenes.caption: ध्रुव ने खड़खड़ाती खिड़की से सिर टिकाया - “भन्न, खट, भन्न, खट - एक स्टॉप।”
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv, an eight-year-old boy in a grey school shirt and a cap pressing his straight hair flat, forehead against a rattling bus window, crowded standing passengers behind him, canvas bag on his knees, hard afternoon light

scenes.narration: He clamped both hands over his ears, but the voices only hummed closer - and he lost count of the stops.
scenes.caption: उसने दोनों हाथों से कान ढके, पर आवाज़ें पास आ गईं और स्टॉप की गिनती छूट गई।
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv with both palms clamped over his ears, eyes shut, mouth pulled sideways, blurred standing passengers filling the bus behind him, canvas bag on his knees, flat daylight

scenes.narration: Then the bus emptied at the market. Only the conductor stayed, and nobody called out the stop names. Three stops left, nothing to count.
scenes.caption: बाज़ार पर बस खाली हो गई, अब स्टॉप के नाम कोई नहीं पुकारता - तीन स्टॉप बाकी।
scenes.image_brief: A nearly empty bus interior with rows of vacant seats and an open door onto a market street, the conductor standing quietly at the front, Dhruv small on a back seat in his grey school shirt and cap with his canvas bag, dust in the light

scenes.narration: So Dhruv rolled his exercise book into a tube and held one end to the rattling window. Listen with me. "Buzz, bump, buzz, bump - one stop."
scenes.caption: ध्रुव ने कॉपी की नली बनाकर खिड़की पर लगाई - मेरे साथ सुनो।
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv holding a rolled-up exercise book like a paper tube, one end pressed to the vibrating bus window frame and the other at his ear, canvas bag on his knees, street sliding past the glass, low daylight

scenes.narration: Count them with me. Dhruv counted three stops through his paper tube and got off at his own lane.
scenes.caption: नली से उसने तीन स्टॉप गिने और अपनी गली पर उतर गया।
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv stepping down from the bus door onto a kerb, the rolled paper tube still in one hand, three fingers held up on the other, canvas bag on his shoulder, warm evening light

scenes.narration: "Buzz, bump, buzz, bump - one stop." Dhruv said it all the way up his lane, and wished the bus would come back.
scenes.caption: “भन्न, खट, भन्न, खट - एक स्टॉप।” ध्रुव चाहता था बस लौट आए।
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv walking up a quiet lane with his canvas bag and the paper tube, looking back over his shoulder at the empty bus pulling away, long shadows
